walk_capacity.base: Self-reported walking duration and activity interference
walk_capacity.entry: Independently mobile, no red flags, no relevant restrictions or unassessed falls
walk_capacity.start: Brief comfortable walking; optional low-tier chair strength after approval
walk_capacity.advance: After repeated tolerable sessions and stable baseline, clinician-approved small change to ONE parameter
walk_capacity.regress: Shorter walking duration, more recovery, supported alternatives
walk_capacity.stop: New chest symptoms, dizziness, worsening weakness, serious pain or new falls; referral

chair_rise.base: Self-reported chair-rise difficulty; standardized test only after clinician approval
chair_rise.entry: Safe chair environment and no instability or recent surgery
chair_rise.start: Arm-assisted sit-to-stand and/or seated leg exercise if approved
chair_rise.advance: Progress aid, repetitions, or seat height one at a time per reviewed criteria
chair_rise.regress: Higher chair, arm support, fewer repetitions
chair_rise.stop: New falls/near falls, marked pain increase, buckling or concerning symptoms

workday_capacity.goal: Make workday standing and moving more manageable
workday_capacity.base: Functional interference at work; tolerable duration on feet
workday_capacity.entry: Screen exertional symptoms, occupational demands, pain causes and environment
workday_capacity.start: Gentle movement breaks, low-tier strength and comfortable activity
workday_capacity.advance: Increase volume on tolerated days only, not fixed 10–20% weekly
workday_capacity.regress: Shorter bouts, more breaks, fewer loaded movements
workday_capacity.stop: Exertional chest symptoms, faintness, marked swelling or worsening symptoms

morning_mobility.base: Minutes until usual comfortable movement and difficulty with first daily activity
morning_mobility.entry: Exclude inflammatory, rapidly worsening or otherwise concerning presentations from automated pathway
morning_mobility.start: Low-amplitude comfortable seated movements, optional short walk
morning_mobility.advance: Expand comfortable range or time only as suitable
morning_mobility.regress: Less range, shorter duration, sitting alternatives
morning_mobility.stop: New neurologic symptoms, severe night/rest pain or sustained worsening stiffness
